comparison.objective: Place four studs on edge in framing-jig slots and butt them against an end fence; the candidate adjusts gripper hardware.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-part reorientation, slot insertion, and datum registration, not driver/wrench torque coupling.
comparison.success_condition: Each stud is upright, square, centered, seated, still, and within 2 mm of the fence for full credit; candidate requires a locked angular setting and cycles.
comparison.reason: All three versions test repeated lumber placement, not adjustment retention.
